normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied seed only exists to feed runMachine's randomness and should be collapsed into the function node.
times is the loop bound of runMachine and carries no independent state.
cardId is only meaningful inside the card-adding routine and should be folded into it.
amount controls the add loop of addCardNotMintedWithAmount and is not a persistent entity.
The parameter shadows the state variable and is only used in the ineffective assignment inside changeShuffleCount.
seed is a transient derivation of userProvidedSeed and msg.sender local to runMachine.
randomResult is a per-iteration scratch value within runMachine's draw loop.
result is an intermediate index consumed immediately by _updateRound inside runMachine.
price is the transient total charged by runMachine and has no independent semantics.
burnAmount is computed and spent entirely within _transferAndBurnToken.
remainingAmount is an intermediate subtraction used only inside _transferAndBurnToken.
transferAmount is a transient per-account share used only inside _transferAndBurnToken's loop.
cardId is a loop-scoped value that only drives _distributePrize's transfer/mint decisions.
cardId is fetched and immediately written back to the round inside _updateRound.
